# dsh-serial-sifarCRT
A SecureCRT-style **Windows serial debug console** that lives in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **right
sidebar**. Configure a COM port from a dialog, connect, watch hardware debug output with ANSI colors
, and type Linux commands directly into the log window — with several serial ports open side by side
e Linux commands directly into the log window — with several serial ports open side by side in tabs.
> 中文简介见下方「中文说明」。
sifarCRT connected to a board: per-line ANSI colors (`[I]` cyan, `[D]` green, `[E]` red, plain kerne
l lines white), the in-log `#` terminal with blinking caret, command buttons, and the keyword log se
hite), the in-log `#` terminal with blinking caret, command buttons, and the keyword log search row.
The serial settings dialog: auto-enumerated COM port with adapter description, editable baud rate, p
arity, flow control, data bits and stop bits.
Running inside the DSH right sidebar next to the conversation, with the board log streaming in and t
he `#` command prompt ready.
## Features
- **Right sidebar panel** — registered as a native right-sidebar tab type (`sifarCRT` in the right c

olumn's guide). Opening it does not replace the built-in right-sidebar pages.
- **Serial settings di
alog** — a gear button opens one dialog with port (auto-enumerated, with adapter descriptions), baud
rate (editable, presets 9600 / 115200 / 1500000, default 1500000, valid 50–1500000), parity (defaul
t None), flow control (default 无/None), data bits and stop bits. Confirm, then Connect/Disconnect fr

om the toolbar.
- **ANSI colors** — Linux ANSI SGR sequences such as `ESC[0m`, `ESC[36;22m` and `ESC
[7m` are parsed and rendered (16 / 256 / truecolor, bold, dim, italic, underline, reverse, hidden).
Colors are applied **per log line**: the color set at the start of a line colors that line, while li
nes with no ANSI (kernel/plain output) use the default text color — no bleed-over into following lin
es. Other cursor/clear control sequences are hidden instead of shown as garbage. A streaming parser

keeps state across serial chunks.
- **In-log Linux terminal** — click the log pane and type directly
: green `#` prompt with a blinking caret, `Enter` sends (an empty Enter sends a bare CR so the board
prints its prompt), `Backspace`, `↑/↓` command history, `Ctrl+V` paste (multi-line paste sends line
by line), `Escape` to leave the keyboard. `Ctrl+C` sends a single `0x03` (ETX) to interrupt a foreg

round program such as `top`; with text selected it copies instead.
- **Keyword search** — a search b
ox highlights every match in the visible log (current match emphasized), with 上一个/下一个 navigation, an
`n/m` counter and a clear button. `Enter` goes to the next match, `Shift+Enter` to the previous, `E

scape` clears; navigating centers the match and pauses auto-follow.
- **Log scrolling that stays out
of the way** — pressing the left mouse button in the log pauses auto-follow while data keeps arrivi
ng; releasing at the bottom resumes. Dragging the scrollbar up keeps the old view without jumping on

new data; scrolling back to the bottom, pressing `Enter`, or clicking “已暂停 · 跟随最新” resumes.

## Requirements
- **Windows** (uses the in-box Windows PowerShell 5.1 + .NET `System.IO.Ports`; no native Node modul

e and no compiler are needed).
- **DSH `^0.2.1-rc.1`** (the right-sidebar tab API of dsh 0.2.1+).
-
No package dependencies, no build step.

Replace `web` with your profile name (Desktop users: install from **Settings → Plugins** instead). A
fter installation, refresh the DSH page once and open the right sidebar → **sifarCRT** in the guide.
Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-serial-sifarcrt`.
## How it works
| Half | File | Responsibility |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Multi-session manager, `POST/GET /dsh-serial-sifarcrt/*` HTTP API on `ctx.

webServer`, bounded per-session logs |
| Host | `lib/serial-helper.ps1` | One persistent Windows Pow

erShell child per serial session, `System.IO.Ports` over NDJSON stdio |
| Client | `lib/client.js` |
Right-sidebar tab-type registration, ANSI renderer, in-log terminal, settings dialog, tabs, command
chips (React, no build step) |
The full Host↔Client protocol contract is documented in docs/CONTRACT.md.
The plugin needs **no network access**. It reads/writes the local COM ports you select and stores ta
b/command/line-ending preferences in the page's `localStorage`. It spawns `powershell.exe` children
that it owns and terminates with the plugin.
## Security notes
- Installing any DSH plugin runs third-party code with your user permissions. This plugin only opens

the serial ports you explicitly connect and does not send data anywhere.
- `OS`-limited to Windows;

the Host half will not start its serial bridge on other platforms.
- The optional diagnostics endpo
int writes a mount report to the OS temp directory (`dsh-serial-sifarcrt-report.json`) for troublesh
ooting; it contains no serial data.

## Known limitations

- One port is exclusive: a COM port already held by another program cannot be opened.
- The log is a
record view: ANSI colors are honoured, but cursor movement / clear-screen sequences are ignored rat

her than reflowing text (progress bars may appear as several lines).
- Paused scroll keeps the rende

red position; when the 2000-line render cap is hit, the oldest rendered lines are dropped.

en the 2000-line render cap is hit, the oldest rendered lines are dropped.
- Windows-only by design.
